new_items.label: Gameplay animation sustains a measured 60 fps on supported target hardware
new_items.reason: The user requested 60 fps. Motion is finite and responsive in current captures, but sustained frame timing has not been measured on every target. The Android TCG guest is unsuitable for that measurement and crashed during the match.

notes: The four routes, controls, shared protocol, public-rule inventory, role matrix, error/empty/reconnect states, four responsive layout families, original assets/licenses, semantics, production HTTP mode and rebrand surface were revisited. The current web/iOS/macOS run completed one match with identical FENs, move list, BPGN, result and score. Seven current normalized visual comparisons are zero and all three negative controls are nonzero. The current four-platform run remains failed: Android registered and played two moves, then system_server exited with SIGSEGV and the room correctly recorded Board B abandonment. The missing measured frame-rate requirement was added rather than inferred as passing.
